text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: One day, while out and about with<n>Symboli Rudolf...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Look there, Trainer. Do you see that?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She points towards a claw machine.<n>The prizes
seem to be plushies<n>shaped like Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What a marvelous variety of designs.<n>Rather
charming, wouldn't you<n>agree?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
They would look perfect in the<n>student council
office... Hmmm, what<n>to do...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf falls silent as she<n>stares at the
plushies.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm rather unused to these<n>amusement centers.
Truth be told,<n>I've never played a claw machine
before.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Part of leading is choosing the right<n>person for the
job. I would be a fool<n>to refuse.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I eagerly await your success, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
